title: Aetheris: Neural Code Synthesis Engine
tagline: AI-powered AST-aware code transformer & real-time documentation generator
description: An intelligent developer copilot engine that analyzes Abstract Syntax Trees (AST) in real-time, generates contextual documentation, and refactors legacy codebases into modern TypeScript paradigms.
detailedOverview: Aetheris was engineered during a 48-hour club innovation sprint to reduce developer cognitive load. It features an in-browser code editor paired with a local quantized model backend, achieving sub-100ms inference times on modern consumer hardware.
architecture: Client frontend built with React and Vite; communication over WebSockets; Python FastAPI backend with PyTorch ONNX runtime; AST parsing with Tree-sitter.
keyFeatures: Real-time Abstract Syntax Tree semantic parsing
Context-aware automated documentation generation
Zero-latency WebAssembly token stream preview
Privacy-first local model execution fallback

title: Hyperion 3D: Spatial Campus Meta-Twin
tagline: Photorealistic interactive digital twin of the university campus
description: An interactive WebGL-powered 3D spatial metaverse representation of the college campus, featuring real-time room occupancies, event heatmaps, and immersive navigation paths.
detailedOverview: Hyperion represents a leap into spatial web engineering. Using procedural meshes and optimized low-poly LOD techniques, the entire 50-acre university grounds are navigable in real-time on standard mobile browsers.
architecture: React Three Fiber with custom Three.js shader materials, glTF Draco compression, and real-time MQTT telemetry synchronization.
keyFeatures: Optimized 60 FPS rendering on budget laptops and mobile devices
Interactive 3D building interior walkthroughs
Live sensor IoT overlay showing lab workstation availability
Dynamic weather & time-of-day solar lighting simulation

title: QuantumPulse: Distributed High-Throughput Message Queue
description: A high-performance distributed event streaming platform built in Go and Python, designed to handle up to 250,000 requests per second with Raft consensus and disk-backed append-only logs.
detailedOverview: Built by the Systems Engineering squad to power all internal club services and high-traffic event ticketing, QuantumPulse demonstrates robust fault tolerance and zero data loss across network partitions.
architecture: Custom Raft leader election algorithm in Go; zero-copy kernel disk writing; Python SDK with asynchronous async/await client drivers.
keyFeatures: Sub-millisecond P99 latency across distributed nodes
Automatic leader failover with Raft consensus protocol
Prometheus & Grafana telemetry dashboards built-in
Memory footprint under 32MB per node at baseline

title: SynapseML: Edge Vision for Automated Attendance
tagline: Real-time edge facial recognition with anti-spoofing detection
description: An edge AI biometric platform engineered for university lecture halls that identifies multiple student faces concurrently while preventing 2D photo spoofing using depth estimation.
detailedOverview: SynapseML eliminates traditional paper sign-in queues by streaming 1080p camera feeds through a lightweight MobileNet backbone on Raspberry Pi 5 hardware, verifying 60+ students in under 5 seconds.
architecture: Python OpenCV video processing pipeline; TensorRT inference acceleration; SQLite encrypted local cache synced with cloud database via REST API.
keyFeatures: Multi-face bounding box tracking at 30 FPS
Liveness detection with blink and texture analysis
Automated attendance report generation with export to CSV/PDF
GDPR-compliant anonymized cryptographic face embedding storage

title: DevSphere: Collaborative Web IDE & Sandbox
tagline: In-browser collaborative code editor with instant containerized execution
description: A browser-based cloud IDE featuring Google Docs-style real-time multiplayer editing, syntax tree analysis, integrated terminal, and sandboxed Docker code runners for 15+ languages.
detailedOverview: DevSphere was crafted to power Codex onboarding workshops. Students open a URL and immediately start coding in C++, Python, or Rust without needing local environment configuration or compiler setups.
architecture: Monaco Editor embedded inside React; CRDTs via Yjs for conflict-free real-time collaboration; isolated ephemeral Linux containers managed by Nomad.
keyFeatures: Operational Transform / CRDT conflict-free multiplayer typing
Integrated Xterm.js interactive cloud terminal
Instant shareable session links with permissions control
Resource-constrained sandbox preventing CPU/Memory starvation

title: BioTrack: Telemetry Wearable Health Analytics
tagline: Cross-platform mobile dashboard for real-time sports biometric signals
description: A high-fidelity mobile application interfacing with BLE heart rate and accelerometer sensors to compute real-time stress indices and predictive recovery metrics.
detailedOverview: Developed in collaboration with the sports department to track athlete conditioning, BioTrack captures raw ECG/PPG wave signals and performs on-device spectral analysis.
architecture: React Native frontend connected to custom ESP32 Bluetooth peripheral; Python scientific analysis pipeline; local SQLite sync.
keyFeatures: Real-time ECG waveform rendering at 120Hz
Heart Rate Variability (HRV) autonomic balance analysis
Encrypted export compatible with medical health records
Offline-first sync queue for remote training camps
